rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for the act or ritual of driving out ghosts or evil spirits.

example.english: This house used to be haunted all the time, so the owner hired a master to perform an exorcism.
example.traditional: 呢間屋以前成日鬧鬼，屋主請咗師傅嚟驅鬼。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 uk1 ji5 cin4 seng4 jat6 naau6 gwai2 uk1 zyu2 ceng2 zo2 si1 fu2 lai4 keoi1 gwai2

rows.note: Use this for exorcism when the emphasis is on demons or in a more formal or media-style context.

example.english: The report said that the priest was performing an exorcism in the church.
example.traditional: 報道話，神父當時正喺教堂入面進行驅魔儀式。
example.jyutping: bou3 dou6 waa6 san4 fu6 dong1 si4 zing3 hai2 gaau3 tong4 jap6 min6 zeon3 hang4 keoi1 mo1 ji4 sik1

rows.note: Use this when the ritual is described broadly as dispelling evil or malign spiritual influences, not necessarily possession.

example.english: For the new shop's opening, the owner had an exorcism performed for peace of mind.
example.traditional: 新店開張，老闆請師傅做驅邪儀式，求個安心。
example.jyutping: san1 dim3 hoi1 zoeng1 lou5 baan2 cing2 si1 fu2 zou6 keoi1 ce4 ji4 sik1 kau4 go3 on1 sam1
